definition: Difference between recorded unique and active lines
missing_value_handling: NA for missing inputs or negative differences; fold median
selection_decision: Retain original subscription counts in handoff
decision_rationale: Tests the subscription count gap
validation_evidence: Active lines plus gap matched the original two-count model at reported precision. Gap alone reduced lift in two of three folds at 10% and 30%.
limitations: Difference cannot identify individual cancelled lines.
logistic_recommendation: Keep both original counts; avoid adding their exact difference as a third linear term
random_forest_recommendation: Both raw counts in handoff; alternate gap representation requires forest validation

definition: Tenure association varies with device age
missing_value_handling: Fold-impute source fields; learn spline within fitting rows
selection_decision: Primary logistic candidate with missingness and main effects
decision_rationale: Tests joint lifecycle and equipment age
validation_evidence: With missingness, focused lift rose from 1.435 to 1.495 at 10%; all folds improved at all three cutoffs. Interaction alone fell in one 10% fold.
limitations: Association cannot establish the effect of upgrades.
logistic_recommendation: Include with missingness and both main effects in primary candidate
random_forest_recommendation: Use numeric tenure and equipment age; forest can learn their interaction
